## Standing operator rules
Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.  
I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.  
please keep commits small so review stays easy.  
Always use db-stg-2.  
Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Webhook file: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Staging DB: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded. Indexes: `invoices_tenant_updated_idx`; unique `search_vectors_tenant_document_idx` on `(tenant_id, document_id)`. Chunk size: 100; workers: 8.

## Ruled-out approaches
Tenant-less invoice scan; per-invoice embedding; unbatched 100-document mock; webhook retry decorator with 5 attempts, because it resent customer emails.

## Recent work
Invoice typing/calculations passed 34 billing tests and 96 full tests. A separate credit-after-refund test failed (`expected 87.50`, received `90.00`); a `make_invoice` test helper was added. `packages/order_core` step 3 exports `calculate_total`; package procedure steps 4–8 remain.
